name: outputty
description: A plugin for developing with Claude Code: /plan interviews, spikes every level, takes your pick and files one ticket; /tickets picks the next, or prints a loop goal that builds every buildable ticket; /research ends in a reference document; /build takes it to one PR under a /goal, docs last, or to one stacked PR per layer when you label the ticket stack. Tickets live in GitHub Issues, through the tracker skill. /outputty:init copies the rules and the user skills under ~/.claude/ and the templates into the repo; /outputty:dream turns the friction in past sessions into measured edits to them.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: The plugin skills init, herdr, dream and eval, each as /outputty:<name>; the standing lines, through a SessionStart hook; and a forced output style. /outputty:init copies the code rules, a rule file per language, the user skills (plan, prototype, research, tickets, build, review, audit, tracker, documentation, typescript-node, ts-pattern, tsup, typed /<name>), a ticket template, a PR template, a README template and settings; each copy is yours, and a re-run lists template changes as offers. A build runs under /goal; review is /review.
